questions.question: A mixture contains alcohol and water in the ratio of 3 : 4. On adding 8 litres of water, the ratio of alcohol to water becomes 5 : 8. The original quantity of the mixture (in litres) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The original quantity of mixture = 3x + 4x = 7x

According to the question,

⇒ (3x)/(4x + 8) = (5)/(8)

⇒ 24x = 20x + 40

⇒ x = 10

The original quantity of mixture = 7 x 10 = 70 litre

**∴ The original quantity of the mixture is 70 litre.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**Given:

In an initial mixture ratio of alcohol and water = 3 : 4.

**Calculation:**

Let the quantity of alcohol = 3k

Quantity of water = 4k

The original quantity of mixture = 3k + 4k

⇒ 7k

According to the question,

⇒ (3k)/(4k + 8) = (5)/(8)

⇒ 24x = 20x + 40

⇒ x = 10

The original quantity of mixture = 7 x 10 = 70 litre

∴ The original quantity of the mixture is 70 litre.

questions.question: Find the least number of five digits which is exactly divisible by 18, 21 and 24 .
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Smallest number of five digit = 10000

LCM of 18, 21 and 24 = 504

Now,

10000 ÷ 504 

⇒ Quotient = 19 and Remainder = 424

⇒ Divisor = 504 and Dividend = 10000

Required number = Dividend + (Divisor - Remainder)

⇒ 10000 + (504 - 424)

⇒ 10080

**∴ Required number is 10080.**

questions.question: What is the difference between the compound interest compounded annually and the simple interest on ₹5,000 at the rate of 8% per annum for 2 years?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Difference for 2 years = PR²/(100)² 

⇒ 5000 x 64/ 10000 = 32

**∴ Difference for 2 years is ₹32. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Principle = ₹5,000

Rate per annum = 8%

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest = (Principle x Rate per annum x Time)/100

Compound interest = P[(1 + (r)/(100))^t - 1] 

**Calculation:**

SI = 5000 x 8 x 2/100 = 800

CI = 5000[(1 + (8)/(100))² - 1]

⇒ CI = Rs. 832

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = 832 - 800

⇒ 32

∴ Difference for 2 years is ₹32.

questions.question: The average weight of 8 people increases by 2.5 kg if a new person replaces one weighing 50 kg. What is the weight of the new person?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

 The average weight which is increase than the replacement of one man will also increase the weight of the all men.

Then weight of the new person = Weight of the replaced person + (total men x average weight increase)

50 + (8 x 2.5) = 70 kg

**∴ Then weight of the new person is 70 kg.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Given:

Weight of the replaced person = 50 kg

Average weight increase of 8 person = 2.5 kg

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of observation / Number of observation

Sum of observation = Average x Number of observation

**Calculation:**

Let average weight of 8 person = a

then total weight = 8a

and New person weight = X

New total weight = 8a - 50 + X

According to question,

⇒ (8a - 50 + X) ÷ 8 = a + 2.5

⇒ 8a - 50 + X = 8a + 20

⇒ X = 70 kg

∴ Then weight of the new person is 70 kg.

questions.question: Four numbers are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5 : 7 and their HCF is 6 . What is the sum of the squares of the largest and the smallest numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Smallest number = 6 x 2 = 12

Largest number = 6 x 7 = 42 

According to question

⇒ (42)2 + (12)2 = 1908

∴ Sum of the squares of the largest and the smallest number is 1908.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Ratio of four number = 2 : 3 : 5 : 7 

Their HCF = 6

**Concept used:**

Number = HCF x ratio of number

**Calculation:**

Smallest number = HCF x smallest ratio

⇒ 6 x 2 = 12

Largest number = HCF x largest ratio

⇒ 6 x 7 = 42 

According to question

⇒ (42)² + (12)²

⇒ 1764 + 144 

⇒ 1908

**∴ Sum of the squares of the largest and the smallest number is 1908.**

questions.question: A retailer buys an item of marked price ₹16,500 at a 12% discount and sells it at 18% profit. Then what is the selling price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 16,500

Discount % on marked price = 12%

Profit % = 18%

**Formula used:**

Selling price at profit = Cost price x (100 + profit%)/100

**Calculation:**

Cost price for retailer after discount = 16500 x 88/100

⇒ Rs. 14,520

Selling price at 18% profit = 14520 x 118/100

⇒ Rs.17,133.60

**∴ The selling price is Rs. 17133.60.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• Profit = Selling price - Cost price 
 
• Profit% = [(Selling price - Cost price) × 100] ÷ Cost price
 
• Selling price at profit = Cost price x (100 + profit%)/100
 
• Loss = Cost price - Selling price
 
• Loss% = [(Cost price - Selling price) × 100] ÷ Cost price
 
• Selling price at loss = Cost price x (100 - loss%)/100
 
• Selling price at discount = Marked Price x (100 - discount%)/100

questions.question: A 243 long train running at 60 km/h takes 42 seconds to cross a tunnel. The length (in m) of the tunnel is:

questions.question: In a transaction, the profit percentage is 48% of the cost. If the cost further increases by 20% but the selling price remains the same, how much is the decrease in the profit percentage?

Let Cost Price = 100 

Selling price = 148

New cost price = 120

New Profit % = (148 - 120) x 100/120 = 70/3%

Decrease in profit percentage = 48 - (70)/(3) = 24.67%

**∴ Decrease in profit percentage is 24.67%.**

**Calculation:**

⇒ 148

New cost price = 100 x 120/100

⇒ 120

New Profit % = (148 - 120) x 100/120

⇒ 28 x 5/6

⇒ 70/3%

Decrease in profit percentage = 48 - (70)/(3)

⇒ (144 - 70)/3

⇒ 24.67%

∴ Decrease in profit percentage is 24.67%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**When the percentage (%) or fraction (a/b) or ratio (a : b) is given in the question and the answer is also to come out in the percentage (%) or fraction (a/b) or ratio (a : b), then there is no need to take the real value.

1 hour = 3600 sec

**Calculation:**

⇒ 45 km/h x 5/18

⇒ 12.5 m/s

Now,

Length of train = Train cover the distance in 1 second.

⇒ 12.5 m/s x 12 sec

⇒ 150 m

questions.question: If the radius of the base of a cylinder is increased by 20% and its height is decreased by 33 (1)/(3) \%, then what will be the change in percentage in its volume?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

⇒ Increase in radius = 20 + 20 + (20 times 20)/(100) = 44%

⇒ Total increase/decrease = 44 - (100)/(3) - (44 times 100)/(100 times 3)

⇒ (132 - 100 - 44)/3

⇒ - 4% [(-) denote decrease ]

**∴ Percentage change in volume is decreased by 4%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Given:

Radis of cylinder is increased = 20%

Decrease of height = 33 (1)/(3) \% 

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr2h 

(where r = radius and h = height)

Equivalent increase or decrease = ± a ± b ± (a × b)/100

**Calculation:**

Initial volume of cylinder = πr2h 

Radius after 20% increase = r x 120/100 

⇒ New radius = 6r/5

Height after 33 (1)/(3) \% = 100 over 3 %decrease = h x (100 - (100)/(3)%)

⇒ h x ((200)/(3)%)

⇒ h x ((200)/(3 times 100))

⇒ New height = (2h)/(3)

New volume of cylinder = π({6r over5})²​2h over 3

​⇒ New volume = (24)/(25) πr²h​​

Now,

Decrease in volume = πr2h - (24)/(25) πr²h

⇒ πr²h over 25

​​Percentage decrease in volume = (πr²h times 100)/(25 times πr²h) 

⇒ 4%

∴ Percentage change in volume is decreased by 4%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Percentage increase or decrease = (New observation - old observation) x 100/ old observation

If successive increase is a% and b% then equivalent increase = a + b + (a x b)/100

If successive decrease is a% and b% then equivalent increase = - a - b + (a x b)/100

If successive increase is a% and decrease is b% then equivalent increase or decrease = a - b - (a x b)/100

questions.question: The average of the marks scored by Amit in 5 subjects is 72. If the average of the marks scored in 3 of these subjects is 70, then what is the average of the marks in the remaining subjects?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Average marks in the remaining subjects = ((5 times 72) - (3 times 70))/(2)

⇒ (360 - 210)/(2) = 75

**∴ Average marks in the remaining subjects is 75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Average marks of 5 subject = 72

Average marks of 3 subject = 70

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of observation) ÷ (Number of observation)

Sum of observation = Average x (Number of observation)

**Calculation:**

Sum of the 5 subjects = 5 x 72 = 360

Sum of the 3 subjects = 3 x 70 = 210

⇒ Remaining subject = 5 - 3 = 2

Sum of the remaining 2 subjects = 360 - 210 

⇒ 150

Average of the remaining 2 subjects = 150/2

⇒ 75

∴ Average marks in the remaining subjects is 75.

questions.question: If (a + b - c) : (b + c - a) : (a + c - b ) = 4 : 5 : 9, then a - b : c - b : c - a=
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(a + b - c) : (b + c - a) : (a + c - b ) = 4 : 5 : 9

**Calculation:**

a + b - c = 4 ------(1)

b + c - a = 5 ------(2)

a + c - b = 9 ------(3)

Addition the equation (1) and (2)

⇒ 2b = 9 ⇒ b = 9/2

Addition the equation (2) and (3)

⇒ 2c = 14 ⇒ c = 7

Addition the equation (1) and (3)

⇒ 2a = 13 ⇒ a = 13/2

Now, 

a - b : c - b : c - a = (13/2 - 9/2) : (7 - 9/2) : (7 - 13/2)

⇒ 2 : 5/2 : 1/2

⇒ 4 : 5 : 1 (LCM of 2 and 2 is 2)

**∴ (a - b) : (c - b) : (c - a) = 4 : 5 : 1.**

questions.question: X takes twice as much time as Y and thrice as much time as Z to finish a job. Working all together, they can finish it in 2 days. Y alone can finish the job in:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

 X : Y : Z

Days 6 : 3 : 2

Efficiency 1/6 : 1/3 : 1/2 

(Efficiency is inversely proportional to days)

⇒ Efficiency 1 : 2 : 3 

If they work together then finish it in 2 days ,

so total work = (1 + 2 + 3) x 2 = 12 unit

Y alone can finish the job = 12/2 = 6 days

**∴ Y alone can finish the job = 6 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

X takes twice as compare to Y and thrice as compare to Z to finish a job. 

If working all together, they can finish it in 2 days

**Concept used:**

Efficiency is inversely proportional to days

Total work = (Sum of Efficiency) x total days

A person alone can complete the job = Total work/ Efficiency of alone person

**Calculation:**

Let Z alone can complete the job = 2k days

Y alone can complete the job = 3k days

X alone can complete the job = 6k days

Now,

 X : Y : Z

Days 6k : 3k : 2k

Efficiency 1/6k : 1/3k : 1/2k 

(Efficiency is inversely proportional to days)

⇒ Efficiency 1k : 2k : 3k 

(LCM of 6, 3 and 2 is 6)

If they work together then finish it in 2 days

⇒ So, total work = (1k + 2k + 3k) x 2

⇒ 12k unit

⇒ Y alone can finish the job = 12k/2k = 6 days

∴ Y alone can finish the job = 6 days.

questions.question: An iron is bought for ₹ 210. Decide its MRP so that after a discount of 5%, you still gain 90%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ 210 times (190)/(100) = MRP times (95)/(100)

⇒ MRP = Rs. 420 

**∴ The MRP is Rs. 420.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

CP = Rs. 210

**Formula used:**

Selling price at profit = Cost price x (100 + profit%)/100

Selling price at discount = Marked Price x (100 - discount%)/100

**Calculation:**

SP for gain 20% = 210 x 190/100

⇒ Rs. 399

According to question,

MRP x 95/100 = 399

⇒ MRP = Rs. 420 

∴ The MRP is Rs. 420.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Profit = Selling price - Cost price

Profit% = [(Selling price - Cost price) × 100] ÷ Cost price

Selling price at profit = Cost price x (100 + profit%)/100

Loss = Cost price - Selling price

Loss% = [(Cost price - Selling price) × 100] ÷ Cost price

Selling price at loss = Cost price x (100 - loss%)/100

Selling price at discount = Marked Price x (100 - discount%)/100
